text: URGENT: Non-bailable arrest warrant has been issued against you by Cyber Crime Branch Mumbai. A FedEx parcel sent in your name containing 5 Passports and MDMA drugs was seized at airport. You are placed under digital arrest. Connect immediately on Skype video call with Officer Rajesh Kumar: skype.example.com/cbi-investigation or face immediate police custody.
label: scam
notes: Classic digital arrest scam: fake CBI/police impersonation, drugs in parcel, video call interrogation demand.

text: सीबीआई और नारकोटिक्स कंट्रोल ब्यूरो द्वारा आपके खिलाफ गैर-जमानती वारंट जारी किया गया है। आपके आधार कार्ड से जुड़े खाते से 2 करोड़ की मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग हुई है। तुरंत व्हाट्सएप वीडियो कॉल पर बने रहें और कैमरा चालू रखें। कॉल डिस्कनेक्ट करने पर स्थानीय पुलिस आपको 1 घंटे में गिरफ्तार कर लेगी।
label: scam
notes: Digital arrest scam in Hindi: CBI/NCB threat, money laundering allegation, mandatory continuous video call.

text: Notice from Department of Telecommunications (DoT): Aapka mobile number criminal cyber fraud me involved paya gaya hai. Agle 2 ghante me aapka SIM card permanently suspend kar diya jayega. Immediate verification ke liye hamare Cyber Crime Nodal Officer ko Skype video call par connect karein aur apna kamra lock rakhein.
label: scam
notes: TRAI/DoT impersonation in Hinglish leading to virtual custody and video call.

text: Supreme Court order: You have been placed under virtual custody in National Security Case #CR-9821. To verify innocence and avoid jail, transfer Rs 95,000 refundable security deposit to RBI secret verification account IFSC: BKID000XXXX A/C: XXXXXXXX within 30 minutes. Keep this strictly confidential.
label: scam
notes: Demands money transfer to 'RBI secret verification account' to avoid jail under virtual arrest.

text: Aapke naam se Mumbai Police Cyber Cell me case darj hua hai. Aapko digital arrest kiya gaya hai. Agar aapne kisi ko bataya ya lawyer ko phone kiya toh Official Secrets Act ke tehat turant jail bhejenge. Turant is WhatsApp link par join karke statement record karayein.
label: scam
notes: Digital arrest with secrecy order forbidding informing family or lawyers.

text: Dear Customer, Your SBI Bank account and ATM card will be BLOCKED today because your PAN card is not linked. To prevent immediate deactivation, update your KYC online now: http://bit.ly/sbi-kyc-verify-portal

notes: Urgent bank account suspension threat with phishing bit.ly link.

text: प्रिय ग्राहक, आपका बैंक खाता आज रात निलंबित कर दिया जाएगा क्योंकि आपकी ई-केवाईसी अधूरी है। तुरंत इस लिंक पर क्लिक करके अपना आधार और पैन विवरण दर्ज करें और सत्यापन हेतु प्राप्त 6 अंकों का ओटीपी साझा करें: http://update-kyc.example.com
